verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Embedded Accounting API built for platform-to-platform integrations and an MCP integration for Claude, but nothing mentions any official SDK or client library in any language. A raw API is a developer building block rather than an official SDK, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. Building against official SDKs is a fair question for an API-backed SaaS product, so the axis applies; with no supporting evidence the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
